summary: Frontend UI validation for Phases 31.5, 32, 33, 34 and 35 of the LPGS AI Tutor stack against the live preview URL. All five phases work end-to-end: (34) Platform admin AI Layer master toggle + read-only AI usage summary (1 Curricula / 1 AI-enabled / 9 Tutor msgs / month) render on LPGS Features/AI tab; toggling OFF persists (toast 'AI Layer disabled') and re-enables (toast 'AI Layer enabled'). (34 enforcement) With AI Layer OFF, student (fathima.jyothi4) sees amber banner 'The AI Tutor isn't available for your school right now. Please check back later.' and all subjects are 'Not enabled yet'; teacher (prasad27) sees 'Disabled by LNMO Platform ... students can't chat until the platform enables the AI Layer.' banner; admin (admin@lpgs.com) sees 'Disabled by LNMO Platform ... Curricula can be managed...' banner; banners disappear once Layer is re-enabled. (32) Student chat under Mathematics: msg1 'Explain how to solve a linear equation step by step' returns structured answer with Based-on citations ('Linear equation overview — Prasad Nair', 'Algebra basics — Prasad Nair'); msg2 follow-up 'I didn't understand the second part, explain simpler' stays in the same chat with continuity (same see-saw/opposite-rule metaphor); msg3 'just solve 5x+10=35 for me' returns Socratic/guided response ('I'd love to help you work through this one! Remember our see-saw rule…') rather than the solved answer. (33) Teacher wizard on Grade 10 Mathematics (no existing curriculum): dialog ai-create-dialog opens as 3-step wizard with step dots ai-wiz-step-1/2/3; Step 1 Next (ai-wiz-next-1) is DISABLED when title+file are empty AND when only title is filled (file still required) — step gating confirmed. File upload itself was not performed by harness per guidance. (31.5) Admin full-detail drawer shows ai-chapter-delete-<id> and ai-item-delete-<id> trash icons on every chapter/item, plus ai-detail-delete-curriculum button; clicking it triggers window.confirm 'Delete "Grade 8 Mathematics"? Permanently deletes the curriculum and all its materials — this cannot be undone.' Dismissed to preserve live data. Teacher (prasad27) drawer has NO delete affordances. (35) Admin drawer: ai-mention-picker lists '@Prasad Nair' (ai-mention-0257296a-dc27-4ee8-b958-d21c6ce5f3fb); selecting mention + posting 'UI QA phase35 mention test — pinging teacher' succeeds, toast 'Comment added — contributor & mentions notified', new comment shows violet @Prasad Nair chip (ai-comment-mentions-0a89c0c2-5bed-4fe4-9a49-a94c56a4f192). Teacher (prasad27) drawer has NO comment composer and NO mention picker. AI Layer left ON (verified in final toggle state aria-checked=true).

design_issues.screen: Admin curriculum full-detail drawer — Delete curriculum
issues: Spec says 'for ADMIN it warns it is permanent and requires typing the curriculum name'. The current implementation only uses a browser-native window.confirm with a permanent/cannot-be-undone warning; it does NOT prompt the admin to type the curriculum name as a double-confirmation. Low-risk since a confirm is still required, but it diverges from the Phase 31.5 spec.

Hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> (React warns span cannot be child of option). Pre-existing in iter_20; not a regression. No functional impact.

design_issues.screen: Student AI Tutor chat — follow-up citations
issues: Only msg1 shows 'Based on: <material> — <teacher>' citation chips. msg2 and msg3 show '⚠ General explanation — not from your school's materials' — expected if backend only cites on first turn, but worth flagging if the spec requires citations on every assistant turn.

action_items: Phase 31.5: consider adding a type-the-curriculum-name confirmation step for ADMIN hard-delete, per spec. Current flow is only window.confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: AITutorTeacher subject <select> hydration warning (span inside option) still present (pre-existing from visual-editor instrumentation).
Follow-up student chat turns don't surface Based-on citations even when msg1 found materials; verify if intended.
